contests.office: Clarke County Soil and Water Conservation District Supervisor

measures.title: Clarke County School District one percent educational sales tax (ESPLOST) renewal
measures.summary: Would renew a one percent sales and use tax for educational purposes in the Clarke County School District for up to five years, raising no more than $215,000,000 for listed capital projects such as school renovations and repairs, technology, security upgrades and school buses. Approval would also authorize the school district to issue $75,000,000 in general obligation debt for these purposes.
measures.yesMeans: The one percent education sales tax would continue for up to five years and the school district could issue $75 million in bonds for the listed projects.
measures.noMeans: The education sales tax would not be renewed when the current tax expires, and the bonds would not be authorized.

measures.id: Special Election: One (1%) Percent Floating Local Option Sales and Use Tax
measures.title: Athens-Clarke County floating local option sales tax (FLOST)
measures.summary: Would impose a special one percent sales and use tax for five years within the special district of Athens-Clarke County. The proceeds would be used only to reduce property taxes imposed by the Unified Government of Athens-Clarke County, the City of Winterville and the Town of Bogart.
measures.yesMeans: A one percent sales tax would be imposed for five years, with all proceeds used to reduce local property taxes.
measures.noMeans: The floating local option sales tax would not be imposed.
